clinical_review: DRAFT — written by the engineering team as a starting point. Must be reviewed and approved by the Clinical Lead before use with real clients.
name: Cognitive behavioural therapy
description: Inspired by the areas commonly used to describe CBT competence (structure, collaboration, guided discovery, conceptualisation, homework). Our own wording — not the CTRS or CTS-R scales.

scale.meaning: 1 = not present in this session, 3 = partly present, 5 = strongly and skilfully present

dimensions.label: Agenda and structure
dimensions.description: Agreeing a session agenda and following a clear, flexible structure.

anchors.1: No agenda; the session lacks structure.
anchors.3: An agenda is set but loosely followed.
anchors.5: A collaborative agenda is set and used flexibly to guide the session.

dimensions.label: Collaboration
dimensions.description: Working as a team: shared decisions, checking understanding, inviting feedback.

anchors.5: Clearly collaborative throughout, with regular checks and feedback.

dimensions.label: Guided discovery
dimensions.description: Helping the client discover new perspectives through questions, rather than telling or persuading.

anchors.3: Some questioning, but conclusions are often supplied.
anchors.5: Skilful questioning helps the client reach their own new understanding.

dimensions.label: Focus on key thoughts and behaviours
dimensions.description: Identifying and working with the thoughts, beliefs and behaviours most relevant to the difficulty.

anchors.1: Key thoughts or behaviours are not identified.
anchors.3: Relevant thoughts identified but not worked with.
anchors.5: Central thoughts/behaviours are identified and worked with purposefully.

dimensions.label: Linking to a formulation
dimensions.description: Choosing interventions that fit a shared understanding (formulation) of the client's difficulties.

anchors.1: Interventions seem unconnected to any formulation.
anchors.5: Interventions clearly follow from a shared formulation.

dimensions.label: Between-session work
dimensions.description: Reviewing previous homework and agreeing meaningful tasks for the coming week.

anchors.1: No review or setting of between-session work.
anchors.3: Homework set without clear rationale or review.
anchors.5: Homework reviewed, and a clear, agreed, meaningful task set.

dimensions.label: Summaries and feedback
dimensions.description: Summarising key points and asking for the client's feedback on the session.

anchors.3: An end summary or feedback, not both.
anchors.5: Regular summaries and genuine feedback that shapes the work.
